scenicChapters.title: Passu → Khunjerab Pass
scenicChapters.narrative: The ground tilts up and stays tilted for 214 km. 4693 m of it, taken steadily rather than in one wall — a steady rhythm suits this better than bursts. The height arrives whether you hurry or not.

scenicChapters.title: Khunjerab Pass → Tashkurgan
scenicChapters.narrative: 349 km that neither climbs nor drops much. The road settles into the ground rather than fighting it. This is where a day makes up time without anyone trying. Third and fourth, and very little else.

karakoram-highway.story: From Islamabad it runs 1944 km to the finish; allow about 28 h 17 of riding. The stops in between: Abbottabad, Besham, Chilas and Gilgit. The highest point is about 4,700 m. It crosses from Pakistan into China - carry ID and check vignette or toll rules. It suits an unhurried touring pace.
